named.name: Jericho
named.label: left
named.note: Tell es-Sultan, beside the spring of Ein es-Sultan. The excavations of Kenyon and later teams found the city of this period poorly preserved; its dating remains debated.

named.name: Gilgal
named.label: right
named.note: Israel's camp, a few kilometres east (4:19; 6:11).

moves.text: Each day the army and the ark go up from the camp
They circle the city once a day for six days, seven times on the seventh

p: The mound of Jericho covers only about 4 hectares; a march around it takes well under an hour, which fits seven circuits on one day (6:15).
About the routes. Places are located from OpenBible.info. The lines between them are reconstructions drawn for teaching, not paths the text describes.
